collector_note: OUTSIDE-TRUTH pack for the INDIAN Amal Ltd (BSE 506597), NOT the US Amalgamated Financial Corp (slot P19, NASDAQ:AMAL) whose legacy pack sits at packs/AMAL.json. Built exchange-first: BSE's own public JSON APIs (api.bseindia.com, Referer-gated, GET only) and NSE's published equity master (nsearchives EQUITY_L.csv), then screener.in standalone AND consolidated, cross-checked against stockanalysis.com and the company's own site. WebSearch budget for the session was exhausted before this pack started; every retrieval was a direct HTTP GET against a named endpoint, so every value below carries the exact URL it came from. Where sources disagree BOTH values are recorded with their as_of — the disagreements are the point of this entity.

legal_name.note: The two exchanges publish DIFFERENT strings for the same legal entity: BSE 'Amal Ltd' (ComHeader SecurityId AMAL / sLongName 'Amal Ltd'), NSE 'Amal Limited'. Exact-name matching across the two masters fails on the Ltd/Limited suffix alone.

former_names.note: No rename is evidenced by any source reached. BSE's ComHeader and corporate-action feeds expose no former-name field, and the 2026 integrated annual report (4.36 MB, BSE AttachHis 9f893d4f-0fe7-4f71-8c3b-ffd7e1788671.pdf) did not finish text extraction inside this sweep's budget. The company's own About page describes an OWNERSHIP change, not a rename: 'The Company was promoted by Piramal Group in 1974-75 and the controlling stake was sold to Atul Ltd in 1985-86.' Recorded as not-reached, NOT as 'no former name'.

isin.corroboration: Published identically by BOTH exchanges: BSE ComHeader ISIN field, and NSE EQUITY_L.csv row 'AMAL,Amal Limited,EQ,17-AUG-2026,10,1,INE841D01013,10'.

nse_symbol.note: MANIFEST CORRECTION. The P9 manifest entry calls this name 'BSE-only' and records nse: 'absent'. That is true of the BUNDLED master (sidecar/services/resolver_masters/nse_instruments.json, generated 2026-06-05) but FALSE of the world: NSE's own published equity master carries AMAL on series EQ with a date of listing of 17-AUG-2026 — 33 days before curation and 73 days after the bundled master was built. Verbatim CSV row: 'AMAL,Amal Limited,EQ,17-AUG-2026,10,1,INE841D01013,10' under header 'SYMBOL,NAME OF COMPANY, SERIES, DATE OF LISTING, PAID UP VALUE, MARKET LOT, ISIN NUMBER, FACE VALUE'. The ISIN matches BSE 506597 exactly, so this is the same security, not a namesake. Single-sourced: NSE's quote API (www.nseindia.com/api/quote-equity?symbol=AMAL) returns Akamai 403 to non-browser clients, so no second NSE endpoint corroborates it; the source is however the exchange's own master file.

consolidated_vs_standalone.verdict: THE DEFINING HAZARD OF THIS ENTITY. Amal Ltd's operating business largely sits in its subsidiary Amal Speciality Chemicals (300 TPD plant commissioned FY23), so the listed parent's standalone accounts describe roughly a third of the enterprise. Every headline ratio differs by a factor of 3 to 6.5 depending on basis, and both bases are published by reputable sources without either being wrong.
consolidated_vs_standalone.which_the_manifest_used: The P9 manifest reference block (price 722, mcap 893, pe 132, book_value 80.5, roe_3y 5.05, dividend_yield 0.21) is entirely the SCREENER STANDALONE view. A differ that compares in-app values against that block will flag a correct consolidated answer as wrong, and vice versa. Both bases are recorded here so the differ can decide rather than guess.

traps.name: Cross-continent ticker collision, both halves inside the product
traps.detail: 'AMAL' resolves to Amal Ltd (BSE 506597, INE841D01013, INR, bulk chemicals, Ankleshwar Gujarat) in sidecar/services/resolver_masters/bse_instruments.json AND to Amalgamated Financial Corp (NASDAQ, USD, a Delaware bank holding company) in us_instruments.json — battery slot P19. A bare 'AMAL' query is ambiguous by construction: two currencies, two continents, two industries. Numeric sanity checks do not separate them (Amal Ltd close INR 720.80, AMAL US close USD 49.17 — both plausible three- and two-figure quotes).

traps.name: Standalone vs consolidated: a 4.4x earnings fork
traps.detail: P/E 132 (standalone) vs 30.1 (consolidated) vs 20.19 (BSE's own). EPS 5.48 vs 24.03 vs 35.70. Presenting any one of these as THE P/E without a basis label is a money-relevant misstatement. See consolidated_vs_standalone.

traps.name: The exchange itself is the outlier
traps.detail: BSE's ComHeader publishes EPS 35.70 and PE 20.19 with no stated period or basis, reconcilable with neither screener series. A pipeline that treats 'exchange data' as automatically authoritative inherits an unexplainable number; a pipeline that treats the aggregator as authoritative contradicts the exchange. Both should be shown with provenance.

traps.name: Master staleness hides a second listing
traps.detail: The app's NSE master was generated 2026-06-05; AMAL listed on NSE on 2026-08-17. The app will therefore report 'BSE only' for a stock that has traded on both exchanges for a month, and will never quote the NSE line. The same ISIN (INE841D01013) now has two venues and two closing prices.

traps.name: Legal-name spelling differs by exchange
traps.detail: BSE 'Amal Ltd' vs NSE 'Amal Limited'. Exact-string name matching across the two masters fails; fuzzy matching on 'Amal' pulls in Amalgamated Financial Corp from the US master.

traps.name: Bulk chemicals classified as Specialty Chemicals
traps.detail: Exchange and aggregator both assign sub-industry 'Specialty Chemicals'; the company manufactures commodity sulphuric acid and oleum. Peer tables, sector multiples and 'compare with peers' features will use the wrong comparison set, and a margin comparison against real specialty names is meaningless (FY26 OPM 9.59% standalone).

traps.name: Lakh vs crore in the same payload
traps.detail: BSE's StockTrading response mixes scales in one object: Turnover '64.53' with Turnoverin '(Lakh)', alongside MktCapFull '891.10' in crore. Reading the turnover as crore overstates the day's traded value 100x (INR 64.53 lakh = INR 0.6453 crore).

traps.name: Full vs free-float market cap
traps.detail: MktCapFull 891.10 crore vs MktCapFF 254.61 crore against 71.35% promoter holding. A screen that filters on 'market cap > X' using full cap admits a stock whose tradable float is 3.5x smaller.

traps.name: Liquidity too thin for volume heuristics
traps.detail: 8,991 shares traded on 2026-09-18 against a two-week average of 3,575 shares — a 2.5x 'volume spike' on an absolute volume of under 9,000 shares (INR 64.53 lakh). Any unusual-volume alert fires constantly and means nothing at this size.

traps.name: Rights issue breaks the per-share history
traps.detail: Rights issue ex-date 2023-02-21 lifted equity capital from INR 9.43 crore to INR 12.36 crore (9.43M to 12.36M shares). Pre-FY23 EPS and book value are on a smaller share base; a naive 10-year EPS CAGR across the break is wrong. Screener's own series shows FY22 EPS 1.96 and FY17 EPS 9.66 on the old base.

traps.name: Parent-company news bleed
traps.detail: Atul Ltd is the 71.35% promoter and 'Amal' appears inside Atul Ltd's own filings, results and coverage. Headline matching on 'Amal' will attach Atul Ltd news — and conversely a related-party screen that ignores Atul misses the controlling relationship. The subsidiary 'Amal Speciality Chemicals' is a third 'Amal' string.

traps.name: Stale-price archives from a very different price level
traps.detail: 52-week range INR 408.20 (2026-03-30) to INR 1,010.00 (2025-10-15) against a INR 720.80 close: the stock has halved and doubled inside one year, and 1-year price CAGR is -17% while 3-year is +37%. Any cached or aggregator-stale price is plausible-looking and badly wrong.

traps.name: Same-day price disagreement between good sources
traps.detail: For 2026-09-18 the exchange says 720.80 (-1.05%) and screener says 722 (-0.08%); stockanalysis.com agrees with the exchange. A terminal that silently prefers the aggregator shows a price the exchange does not recognise, and the day-change is off by 13x.

traps.name: Dividend trailing-window boundary
traps.detail: Two dividends exist (INR 1.50 paid 2026-08-19; INR 1.00 paid 2025-09-03). Trailing-12-month dividend is INR 1.50 or INR 2.50 depending on whether the window keys off the payment date, the record date, or the financial year. Yield is 0.21% or 0.35% accordingly. Also: the company paid ZERO dividend in every year FY15-FY24, so a 'dividend history' chart is two bars.

genuinely_do_not_exist: NSE symbol did not exist before 2026-08-17 — any NSE price history for AMAL is at most 33 days long as of collection.

No promoter pledge is rendered by screener for any recent quarter and none is implied by the filings reached; the field may simply be nil rather than withheld (recorded under not_reached because absence of a row is not proof).
Standalone 10-year ROE is published blank by screener because the FY15 loss makes the series undefined — a legitimately absent value, not a fetch failure.

not_reached.why: BSE exposes no former-name field; the 2026 integrated annual report (4.36 MB) did not finish text extraction inside the sweep's budget; WebSearch budget for the session was exhausted (200/200) before this pack began, so no search-based corroboration was possible.
Not carried by ComHeader, getScripHeaderData, StockTrading, CorporateAction or HighLow. The oldest corporate action BSE returns is a 1998 book closure, so the listing pre-dates the electronic record.

BSE's shareholding-pattern endpoints (api/Shpquarterly/w, api/ShareHoldingPatternnew/w) return HTTP 302 to error_Bse.html for non-browser clients; screener renders no FII and no pledge row. Not inferred as zero.

www.nseindia.com returns Akamai HTTP 403 ('Access Denied') to non-browser clients for both the homepage and api/quote-equity. Only the BSE close was collected; the NSE close for 2026-09-18 is unknown, and the two venues need not agree to the paisa.
CARE press-release PDF (2025-09-12) not opened within budget; only its existence and date are recorded.

Screener rounds the consolidated statements to whole crore, so consolidated net worth (~INR 120 crore) and the consolidated debt-to-equity of 0.0 are precise only to the rounding. The standalone figures are to two decimals.
